name: Strawberry Mojito
steps: Rinse and hull strawberries, then finely chop half and lightly mash the rest to make a fresh fruit base.
Put mint and lime wedges into four glasses and press very gently. Divide both chopped and mashed strawberries among them.
Add lime juice and syrup, stir to mix with the fruit, and fill each glass with 100 g ice.
Pour 150 ml chilled club soda into each glass, stir once and serve immediately with visible strawberry pieces.
tips: Light muddling preserves mint’s fresh flavour; crushing it hard makes the drink bitter.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
